title: Learning consequences query exponent
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $Q$, define the learning consequences query exponent to be $8$ times the learning consequences family exponent at $C$ and $Q$, plus $2$.
caveat: The definition of the learning consequences family exponent is not included, so its meaning cannot be stated here.
